name: kweli-mcp
description: The Kweli MCP — every Kweli function in one WorkOS-OAuth-gated server: graph reads (search_places, get_place, get_organization, get_verification, get_open_stats), verification-tier inspection, and place generation (seed_region, seed_admin_bulk, request_place). Generation tools forward to the independent bulk-place-agent / single-place-agent Workers over WorkOS M2M, exactly as any other Nyuchi/Mukoko app would.
